x: Cantering in the background is Michael Crawford (soon to be seen with Barbra Streisand in the Hollywood version of "Hello Dolly") who has just been signed to appear in Michael Winner's next film, "The Games," based on the novel by Hugh Atkinson and researcher Phillip Knightley.
The hero is a British Runner, Harry Hayes, played by Michael Crawford. When preparing for the part Michael joined the Bels and a 1968 magazine shows a picture of him training on Wimbledon Common.
